sentences.en: The company recalled all the baby food made in July.
sentences.zh: 这家公司在七月生产的婴儿食品全部召回。

sentences.en: The journey, as I recall it, was long and tedious.
sentences.zh: 依我所记，那趟旅程又长又乏味。

sentences.en: The ambassador will be recalled from his present post soon.
sentences.zh: 大使很快将被调回目前的岗位。

senses.zh: 召回, 唤回 - 记忆力

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（向后）+call（想）→回忆起
